programs.title: Lakefront Bargain Hunt: Renovation
programs.sub_title: A Renovation for Future Generations on Skiatook Lake
programs.desc: A married couple is on the hunt for a property on Oklahoma's Skiatook Lake, with plans to transform it into the ultimate lakeside retreat; a place to create lasting memories and eventually pass down to future generations of their family.

programs.title: Lakefront Luxury
programs.desc: Jessica is an art dealer and collector, specializing in ancient and tribal artifacts. She's on the hunt for the perfect place to unwind by the water. The challenge is in finding a rustic retreat that can also house her unconventional collection.

programs.title: Lakefront Luxury
programs.desc: Liz and Jake both work in the tech industry; they are recently engaged and are looking for a lakefront property to host their wedding nuptials and move into; their home tours include a home with a cliffside outdoor entertainment area.

programs.title: Lakefront Luxury
